text.en: Every reviewer emphasizes head trainer Jennifer dedication, insightful guidance, and refusal to give up on challenging dogs. Clients note that Jen observes handler-dog dynamics keenly in both private sessions and group settings, stepping in with clear adjustments that quickly resolve training hurdles.

Pet parents report substantial progress in basic obedience, leash pulling, and focus amidst distractions. Multiple reviewers note that Jennifer practical exercises provided lasting solutions for stubborn or adolescent dogs, transforming high-stress walks into structured, cooperative routines.

title.en: Support for anxious and reactive dogs

text.en: Owners of nervous rescues and reactive working breeds praise the balanced approach used to reduce anxiety and build canine confidence. Reviewers appreciate that the training environment encourages calm focus around other dogs while helping handlers understand and manage triggers with reassurance.

q.en: What types of dog training formats are offered?

a.en: Top Dog provides multi-week group obedience classes, tailored private one-on-one sessions, puppy kindergarten, and specialty scent detection courses.

q.en: Does the trainer work with reactive or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently note that Jennifer successfully works with highly reactive dogs, nervous rescues, and stubborn working breeds.

q.en: Where are the training facilities located?

a.en: The Vancouver training hub is located on Shaughnessy Street near the Oak Street Bridge and Fraser River, offering dedicated indoor training spaces.

q.en: How long do foundational obedience programs run?

a.en: Foundational obedience courses typically run as structured six-week programs designed to build handler leadership and reliable canine manners.
